capabilities: register editor and Prism highlighting modes
restyle highlighted tokens with CSS classes
disambiguation: Not a policy editor or validator; it only adds syntax highlighting to code blocks.
extras: Notes the marketplace flag "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff"; mentions a limitation where blocks inside blockquotes and callouts highlight only in Reading view.
problem: Obsidian does not recognize the Cedar policy language, so its code blocks render as unhighlighted plain text.

relations.evidence: The highlighting comes from the TextMate grammars in the official Cedar extension for Visual Studio Code
Notes are highlighted exactly the way VS Code and the Cedar plugin for JetBrains IDEs highlight them

summary: Syntax highlighter that colors fenced Cedar policy and Cedar schema code blocks in the editor, Reading view, embeds and PDF export.
